summary: Allstate's website and app outage is in its fifth day, and the company still has not said why. SAP confirmed a hack of its software code, and 1Password reported a similar break-in. No official source links any of these. Stocks and Bitcoin look normal.

events.title: Allstate website, app and phone outage now in its fifth day
events.impact: Some customers and agents still struggle to pay bills, renew policies, file claims online or get roadside help. Allstate says no one loses coverage or pays late fees. No restoration time given.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Allstate has not given a cause. A Newsweek report, cited by Quartz, says nothing public points to hackers or exposed customer data.

events.title: SAP confirms hackers broke into its software development systems
events.impact: Reports say hackers used stolen employee GitHub tokens to copy or change code. SAP reportedly changed its signing keys. No report says changed code reached customers.
events.stated_cause: Stolen employee login tokens, per Der Spiegel's inside source. SAP has not confirmed those details. Who did it is unknown. SAP says no sign customer business data was reached.

events.title: 1Password reportedly disclosed a break-in through an employee GitHub account
events.impact: One article says the attacker reached private code and a build system, and customer account data was downloaded. I could not check this against 1Password's own notice.
events.stated_cause: An attacker got into an employee's GitHub account. Who did it is unknown. Only one article seen, so this is unconfirmed.

events.title: Wyoming uranium plant still shut after cyber incident
events.impact: Peninsula Energy shut its Lance plant after plant and wellfield control systems were hit. No restart date. It cannot yet say how this affects 2027 output.
events.stated_cause: The company calls it a cybersecurity incident. It has not said who did it or how. It is checking whether data was taken.

events.title: Bell MTS in Canada says an email outage was a cyberattack
events.impact: CTV reports a small group of email users had data stolen. Outside the US. I saw only the headline and a short excerpt.
events.stated_cause: The company says a cyberattack. Who did it is unknown.

events.title: South African investing app EasyEquities locked out customers after cyberattack
events.impact: Customers were locked out. No restore time was given. No newer update found this run. Outside the US.
events.stated_cause: The company emailed customers about a cyberattack with no details. Some people suspect its new app design.

events.title: Thanksgiving week ground stops: DC storm and Miami runway overrun
events.impact: The FAA paused flights to Washington National for thunderstorms. It stopped flights at Miami after a FedEx cargo jet ran off a runway. FAA lists no ground stops now. An O'Hare equipment stop on Nov 24 appears in one report only.
events.stated_cause: Weather in DC. A disabled aircraft in Miami. No injuries were reported in Miami. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: Thanksgiving storm cut power to more than 850,000 customers
events.impact: Virginia, Maryland and Pennsylvania were hit hardest. Latest outage counts were not found this run.
events.stated_cause: Weather. The National Weather Service reported 50 to 70 mph wind gusts along the East Coast.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Hormuz and Houthi strikes on Saudi sites keep oil high
events.impact: Brent crude is about 96 dollars a barrel per the last Reuters-based report. Shipping costs are up. No newer update found this run.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines hit ships. The Houthis claimed the Saudi refinery attacks. The Hormuz claims are not independently confirmed.

events.title: Bitcoin near 60K to 62K USD; no crash found
events.impact: Coinbase 61,463. CoinMarketCap 61,563. OKX 61,732. CoinGecko 59,962. Coinglass 59,642. Prices agree within about 3 percent. Daily moves are roughly -1.4 to +1.5 percent. Sentiment gauge reads extreme fear. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports cite tariff and inflation worries and ETF outflows.

events.title: US stocks rebound on Black Friday after a choppy tech week
events.impact: The Dow and S&P 500 rose about 0.7 percent in the half-day session. Both are up more than 5 percent on the week. No trading halts or exchange glitches found.
events.stated_cause: Market moves tied to AI-stock swings, rate worries and tariff fears. No technical cause reported.

events.title: CISA adds 10 actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers Danfoss, HPE Juniper, Mitel and Vates products. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive. No newer CISA alert in the feed.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not link the flaws to any incident above.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Allstate has not said what caused its outage, and no one has blamed hackers. SAP says it was hacked, reportedly through stolen employee GitHub logins. 1Password reportedly had a similar break-in, but that is one report. Nobody officially links them.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement tying SAP, 1Password or Allstate to the same attacker or company, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No confirmed coordinated attack or widespread failure. Markets and Bitcoin are normal.

prep_note: If you use Allstate, keep proof of any payment and call the company if you are unsure it went through. If your company uses SAP or 1Password, watch for official notices and change passwords if told to. Use official contact details only, and ignore unsolicited messages offering help.
